comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This recipe book is obtainable from Rome's Coliseum for 1,500 Roman Coins (must also defeat Gluttonous Cook first to unlock it from the Exchange Broker shop).

Skill requirements:
Casting R15
Management Technique R10

Recipe 1: Strengthening Stirrup Crossbow
Cast Iron x8 + Stainless Steel x10 + Stirrup Crossbow

Recipe 2: Strengthening Stone Crossbow
Cast Iron x8 + Stainless Steel x10 + Stone Crossbow

Recipe 3: Strengthening Ballista Crossbow
Cast Iron x8 + Stainless Steel x10 + Ballista Crossbow

Cheers.

comments.author: Kurama
comments.body: By strengthening means it can reach 100 ATK?
